━━━ Help · an unknown command ━━━
(sends)
I did not understand that message.

The game is played with the buttons. You can also send these words, with or without "/":
• profile - your home and condition
• crime - crime, in your city's group only
• jail - your time in jail, and bail
• map - your city's map and its places
• job - my job; "jobs" lists the openings
• study - courses
• bank - your balances; "deposit 5000" and "withdraw 5000"
• pay - pay another player; in a group, reply to their message with "pay 5000"
• skills
• friends - and "find" with a player code or username
• city - offices and policies; "office" is your own
• army - your country's ministry of defence and armed forces; "sanctions" and "treaties" its diplomacy
• hospital - your health, a stay and treatment
• missions - your missions; "board" the city's mission boards
• faction - your faction; "factions" the city's factions
• loan - the national bank, your credit score and loans; "savings" and "insurance"
• stocks - company shares; "portfolio" your investments; "gold" the gold dealer
• settings
• help - this screen
  ───
  [👤 Profile] → player:profile.get   │   [🗺 Map] → map:list
  [💼 My job] → job:status   │   [🎓 Education] → education:list
  [🏦 Bank] → bank:show   │   [🛠 Skills] → skills:list
  [👥 Friends] → social:friend.list   │   [⚙️ Settings] → player:settings
